lyrics:
[Intro: solo piano, distant thunder, wind]

[Verse 1: husky female voice; male voice answers]
(Come closer) Every light went at eleven
(Come closer) I can't even see my hand
(Come closer) There's a candle in a jam jar
(Come closer) And a quiet I can't stand

[Verse 2: drums enter softly]
(Come closer) We've had ten years of the weather
(Come closer) Of the news, and of the screen
(Come closer) I forgot you had a voice like that
(Come closer) I forgot what it could mean

[Pre-Chorus: building, both voices]
And I've missed you in plain sight
Let me look at you by this light

[Chorus: full band and choir, enormous]
On the night the power went out
I found you in the dark
We were sitting on the kitchen floor
Like two kids in a park
Thirty years, and I had lost the way to start
The night the power went out
You lit up every part

[Verse 3: quieter, piano and voice]
(Come closer) I've been lonely in the next room
(Come closer) I've been angry, I've been small
(Come closer) I was waiting for a reason
(Come closer) And it only took a squall

[Chorus: full band and choir, enormous]
On the night the power went out
I found you in the dark
We were sitting on the kitchen floor
Like two kids in a park
Thirty years, and I had lost the way to start
The night the power went out
You lit up every part

[Bridge: thunder, band drops, voices overlapping]
Don't let them fix it yet
(Come closer)
Don't let them fix it yet

[Final Chorus: biggest, key up a step, choir soaring]
On the night the power went out
I found you in the dark
We were sitting on the kitchen floor
Like two kids in a park
Thirty years, and I had lost the way to start
The night the power went out
You lit up every part

[Outro: piano, a hum as the lights return, "Leave them off."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 65 BPM, 4/4, A-flat major, up to B-flat major for the final chorus. Slow, theatrical and stormy, with several huge swells.

VOICE: Female lead, husky, cracked and dramatic, quiet in the verses and belting in the choruses. A high, pure male tenor answers her with two sung words before each verse line and overlaps with her in the bridge. A choir fills the choruses.

INSTRUMENTS: Grand piano, thunderous tom-heavy drums, bass, a wall of electric guitars and synthesizers, a choir, glockenspiel and bells, storm sounds, and a hum of electricity at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and thunder. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Verse 2. 1:20 Pre-chorus. 1:32 Chorus 1. 2:10 Verse 3. 2:42 Chorus 2. 3:20 Bridge. 3:42 Final chorus, key up. 4:24 Outro, lights humming on and a spoken line at 4:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1983 theatrical rock: enormous reverb, a wall of sound, quiet passages very quiet and loud ones overwhelming.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The male voice's first '(Come closer)' at 0:16.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young woman's gothic despair. This is a couple of thirty years for whom the drama is ordinary distance, and the eclipse is a power cut that removes every screen in the house.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Uneasy, confessing, found, not wanting the lights back.
